title: EventBus listener order after exception contract

contract.registration_order: Listeners are retained in registration order
contract.delivery_order: EventBus delivers events to listeners in registration order
contract.exception_continuity: A listener exception does not interrupt delivery to subsequent listeners
contract.delivery_after_failure: Listeners registered after a failing listener still receive the event
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after an individual listener raises an exception
contract.registry_stability: Listener exceptions do not modify the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Event emission requires the emitting plugin events permission
